from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowEntry(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash flow data from a single document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    operating_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities; positive if provided, negative if used")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of operating cash flow: 'millions' or 'thousands'")
    investing_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing activities; positive if provided, negative if used")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of investing cash flow: 'millions' or 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_entries: list[CashFlowEntry]
